lessons.trigger_condition: The grading cockpit showed price and predicted grade, but non-Pokémon set context was too vague and the committed purchase source file still exposed only the original three games even though promoted registry games had purchase capability.
lessons.prevention_rule: Keep generation/set context game-specific and evidence-bounded, materialize official/market/map purchase routes for every core/promoted purchase-enabled registry game, keep WATCH blocked, and hand the confirmed card name/number into the existing purchase finder without inventing stock.
validation_required: Pokémon generation remains delegated to the existing evidence-backed generation runtime
ONE PIECE displays only exact observed set-family prefixes and never invents a Pokémon-style generation
NARUTO or unknown non-Pokémon contexts remain explicit when generation/set evidence is insufficient
card measurement can open online or nearby purchase finder with the confirmed card name and number
generated purchase routes cover core/promoted purchase-enabled registry games and keep inventory_verified false
WATCH purchase games remain excluded from real-time purchase routes
compact market evidence shows freshness age and a safe public source link when available
new card-context and purchase-evidence skills are mirrored and routed
lessons.safety_boundary: No copyright year is promoted to a release year, no social/search/video result becomes verified stock or price, no map candidate proves inventory, no WATCH purchase activation is introduced, and physical tablet verification remains separate.
